source_verification.validation_method: Original pure snapshot/artifact/raw validators plus explicit equivalent receipt checks. Current checkout is not represented as an original checkout; native hash execution is replaced by independent verified BLAKE3 readback, without changing the original driver.

timing_interpretation: Supervisor wall is original millisecond resolution for the entire child lifetime/drain. Summed build_finished.wall_us, main parity, and whole fanout replay are disjoint observed intervals; residual is retained unassigned.

build_timing.prepare_us, commit_write_us, postprocess_compute_us, postprocess_apply_us, between_stages_us form the conserved microsecond partition. prepare_snapshot_us and full_staging_us are nested in prepare_us and are never added twice.
Original phase_timing values are individual millisecond floors. They are useful phase attribution, not a complete wall partition; full_staging_us is not represented in those six phases.
stage_finished.incremental_wall_us includes the loop/emission overhead around build calls. It is shown alongside, not added to, sum(build_finished.wall_us).
Fanout contains actual nested checkpoint reports but lacks separate full rebuild timing; its whole replay is kept separate from main-scale build_started/build_finished counts.
Incremental parse_ms includes dependency lookup/reload/parse work. SQL row/VM counters are work measures, not independent wall clocks.
